purpose: Shared semantic motion weapons for every Doré-designed surface. Consumers declare intent; they do not own animation engines.

semantics.meaning: Deliberate non-motion; visual presence carries the state.
A measured reveal that grants importance without spectacle.
A spatial transition from outside to inside; never requires a literal door.
Separate parts resolve precisely into a larger constructed whole.
A restrained continuity transition with minimal visual interruption.
Slow directional movement used only when it adds spatial depth or temporal presence.
A decisive state change derived from editorial sequencing rather than decorative transition.
Elements with unequal visual weight converge into one intentional composition.
Continuity between editorial states while preserving identity of the departing and arriving fields.
Type movement carries semantic or hierarchical meaning; never motion for its own sake.
